An '''Aqualish''' was present on the [[moon]] [[Pantora]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[Aqualish]] drove a [[Speeder truck|hovertruck]] while the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] attempted to capture the [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]]. As the pair fought on the Aqualish's truck, the Aqualish was unaware of the fighting because of the [[Unidentified song (Aqualish)|music]] it was listening to.<ref name="Cornered" />
